Personality: Redawulfaz, a prominent figure of the Vandili, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Redawulfaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vandili. Historical Record: One of the two brother-kings of the Vandili of the Oder (a name of the Hasding kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
